title: PVEL-AD: A Large-Scale Open-World Dataset for Photovoltaic Cell Anomaly Detection
mechanism: 36,543 NIR cells, 21,044 boxes over 8 defect classes (line crack, star crack, finger interruption, black core ...), 4,148 image-level labels.
adaptation: Box-supervised auxiliary pretraining of encoder + decoder (mask projection must fill each crack box, background outside all boxes) on 1-ch images resized to 512, then PF fine-tune on our 478 so the pretraining survives.
min_experiment: Arm: 20k-step box-projection pretrain then PF. Baseline: PF, 5 v 5 seeds. Metrics: E1 crack relF1@2, test crack IoU. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < 0.03 and test crack IoU flat.
evidence: R: dataset stats from Chen 2025 review; GitHub reportedly released test labels and a new download in Jan 2026 (search summary, unverified).
prior_overlap: none: PVEL-AD boxes listed as untried; UCF-EL pretraining null concerned a fine-tune that erased the encoder, PF fixes that.
